Dear Mr. Russo:
From June 4 through December 3, 2024, a representative of the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials
Safety Administration (PHMSA) pursuant to Chapter 601 of 49 United States Code (U.S.C.)
inspected Buckeye Partners, LP’s (Buckeye) construction records and observed excavation of
Tampa Pipelines L931 and L932 as part of a weld validation and testing plan in Allentown,
Pennsylvania, and Tampa, Florida.
As a result of the inspection, it is alleged that you have committed probable violations of the
Pipeline Safety Regulations, Title 49, Code of Federal Regulations (CFR). The items inspected
and the probable violations are:
1.
